# claude-selfhosted-operator

Runs Claude Code self-hosted environments on Kubernetes as fixed or on-demand runner fleets.

This file is generated by `make helm-chart` from `Chart.yaml`, `values.yaml` and
`hack/chart/README.md.gotmpl`; edit those, not this file.

![Version: 0.1.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-0.1.0-informational?style=flat-square) ![Type: application](https://img.shields.io/badge/Type-application-informational?style=flat-square) ![AppVersion: 0.0.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/AppVersion-0.0.0-informational?style=flat-square)

## Install

The newest stable chart, into its own namespace under the Restricted Pod Security Standard:

```bash
kubectl create namespace claude-selfhosted-operator-system
kubectl label namespace claude-selfhosted-operator-system pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=restricted
helm install claude-selfhosted-operator oci://ghcr.io/ahmadmasry/charts/claude-selfhosted-operator \
  --namespace claude-selfhosted-operator-system
```

Pre-releases are skipped unless you pass `--version X.Y.Z-rc.N` or `--devel`.

The chart installs the CRDs (`crd.enabled`) and keeps them on uninstall (`crd.keep`). The manager
image is signed with keyless cosign and carries an SBOM attestation; see
[docs/release.md](https://github.com/AhmadMasry/claude-self-hosted-environment-operator/blob/master/docs/release.md)
for the verification commands.

## Requirements

- Kubernetes 1.30 or later for the `ValidatingAdmissionPolicy` that confines each on-demand
  orchestrator to its own work orders (`admissionPolicy.enabled`); set it to `false` on older clusters.
- With `rbac.namespaced=true`, the manager cannot read the `default/kubernetes` Endpoints, so
  `networkPolicy.apiServerEndpoints` is required whenever an on-demand environment enables
  `spec.runner.networkPolicy`.
- `prometheus.enabled` needs the Prometheus Operator CRDs (ServiceMonitor and PodMonitor).

After installing, create a `ClaudeEnvironment`; see the
[quickstart](https://github.com/AhmadMasry/claude-self-hosted-environment-operator#quickstart).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|-----|------|---------|-------------|
| manager.enabled | bool | `true` | Set to false to skip manager installation |
| manager.replicas | int | `1` |  |
| manager.image.repository | string | `"ghcr.io/ahmadmasry/claude-self-hosted-environment-operator"` |  |
| manager.image.tag | string | `"0.0.0"` | Image tag (defaults to Chart.appVersion if not set) |
| manager.image.pullPolicy | string | `"IfNotPresent"` |  |
| manager.args[0] | string | `"--leader-elect"` |  |
| manager.healthProbe.port | int | `8081` | Health probe server port |
| manager.env | list | `[]` | Environment variables |
| manager.envOverrides | object | `{}` | Env overrides (--set manager.envOverrides.VAR=value) Same name in env above: this value takes precedence. |
| manager.podSecurityContext.runAsNonRoot | bool | `true` |  |
| manager.podSecurityContext.seccompProfile.type | string | `"RuntimeDefault"` |  |
| manager.securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation | bool | `false` |  |
| manager.securityContext.capabilities.drop[0] | string | `"ALL"` |  |
| manager.securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem | bool | `true` |  |
| manager.resources.limits.cpu | string | `"500m"` |  |
| manager.resources.limits.memory | string | `"512Mi"` |  |
| manager.resources.requests.cpu | string | `"10m"` |  |
| manager.resources.requests.memory | string | `"64Mi"` |  |
| manager.affinity | object | `{}` | Manager pod's affinity |
| manager.nodeSelector | object | `{}` | Manager pod's node selector |
| manager.tolerations | list | `[]` | Manager pod's tolerations |
| manager.terminationGracePeriodSeconds | int | `10` | Termination grace period seconds |
| rbac.namespaced | bool | `false` | RBAC resource scope - false (default): ClusterRole/ClusterRoleBinding (all namespaces) - true: Role/RoleBinding (release namespace only) |
| rbac.helpers.enabled | bool | `false` | Install convenience admin/editor/viewer roles for CRDs |
| serviceAccount.enabled | bool | `true` | Install default ServiceAccount provided |
| crd.enabled | bool | `true` | Install CRDs with the chart |
| crd.keep | bool | `true` | Keep CRDs when uninstalling |
| metrics.enabled | bool | `true` |  |
| metrics.port | int | `8443` | Metrics server port |
| metrics.secure | bool | `true` | Enable secure metrics: HTTPS with certs/auth (true) or HTTP (false). Note: Metrics authn/authz needs ClusterRole access. |
| certManager.enabled | bool | `false` |  |
| webhook.enabled | bool | `false` |  |
| webhook.port | int | `9443` | Webhook server port |
| prometheus.enabled | bool | `false` |  |
| networkPolicy.enabled | bool | `false` |  |
| networkPolicy.apiServerEndpoints | list | `[]` | API server addresses (ip:port, IPv6 bracketed) for the orchestrator egress NetworkPolicy of on-demand environments. Empty reads the default/kubernetes Endpoints, which rbac.namespaced=true does not grant: in that mode this list is required whenever an on-demand environment enables spec.runner.networkPolicy. Find the values with: kubectl get endpoints kubernetes -n default |
| admissionPolicy.enabled | bool | `true` | Install the ValidatingAdmissionPolicy that confines each on-demand orchestrator ServiceAccount to its own work orders. Needs Kubernetes 1.30 or later; set to false on older clusters. |
| watchNamespaces | string | `""` | Namespaces the manager watches, comma-separated; empty watches all namespaces (manager flag --watch-namespaces). |
| tracing.endpoint | string | `""` | OTLP gRPC endpoint for traces; empty falls back to $OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, and tracing stays off when neither is set (manager flag --tracing-endpoint). |
| tracing.sampleRatio | float | `0.1` | Fraction of root spans sampled; the manager flag is tracing-sample-ratio. |
